reason: B offers the cleaner controlled comparison and coherent measurable prediction—reducing Ti/Mn while holding the protective-element chemistry as constant as possible, followed by long-duration kinetic and scale characterization—whereas A simultaneously changes Al/Cr content and grain structure, preventing decisive mechanistic attribution, and incongruously predicts a thicker scale with lower mass gain. B still requires verification that suppression of fast-diffusing species, rather than altered oxide thermodynamics, causes the benefit, but it is the more directly falsifiable proposal.
